concerns.text: The plan states that docstrings will be generated with the `Salesforce/codegen-350M-mono` model **quantized to 4‑bit via `bitsandbytes` (CPU‑only)**. `bitsandbytes` 4‑bit quantization is only supported on CUDA‑enabled GPUs; on a CPU‑only runner this configuration will fail to load, making the pipeline infeasible under the free‑tier GitHub Actions constraints.

The compute feasibility table assumes the 4‑bit quantized model fits in ≤1 GB RAM and runs on CPU. Because the 4‑bit mode cannot run on CPU, the RAM estimate is inaccurate and the runtime estimate (≈ 3 h) is optimistic. This violates Principle VII (Deterministic Generation Constraints) and the free‑tier compute budget.
